title: outbox_worker 30s sleep interval is hardcoded with no config override
description: outbox_worker sleeps for a hardcoded 30 seconds between ticks. For high-traffic deployments or responsive UX, this is fine. However for low-power devices or high-latency scenarios, the polling interval cannot be tuned. The discovery interval has KITHD_DISCOVERY_INTERVAL_SECS; the outbox has no equivalent. Not a correctness issue but limits operational flexibility.
